mainEntity.name: Can cracks in interior walls indicate a structural issue?

acceptedAnswer.text: While many small cracks in interior walls are cosmetic due to normal settling or humidity changes, larger or unusually patterned cracks can sometimes indicate a more significant structural issue. Horizontal cracks, stair-step cracks in masonry, or cracks that are wider than a quarter-inch, especially those appearing near door or window frames, warrant further investigation. A professional can assess whether the cracks are superficial or symptoms of underlying foundation or framing problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Some small cracks are cosmetic, but large or patterned cracks, especially wide ones or those near openings, may signal a structural issue. A professional can assess their cause.
